title: RequestEnvelope
description: Unified request envelope (spec A.8 / §26.1). request_id is unique per transport attempt; idempotency_key is REQUIRED for side-effecting payloads.

request_id.description: Unique per transport attempt; MAY change on retry (AR-023).

correlation_ids.description: task_id / changeset_id / execution_id / command_id correlation set.

deadline_at.description: Absolute UTC ISO-8601 deadline (AR-024); MUST NOT be interpreted as remaining_ms.

idempotency_key.description: Identifies one logical side effect; MUST stay stable across retries (AR-023).

payload.description: Type-specific body (HostCommand / HostCommandResult / HostDelta / ErrorShape / HostStatus).
